items.text: Exactly three men are visible in the yard.
One man wears a black puffer jacket and grey trackies.
One man wears a dark green hoodie and jeans.
One man is visibly older than the other two and wears a long dark coat.
Archie is not in the image.
The three men look ordinary and realistic, in their twenties to thirties, not cartoonish.
All three men are standing, not crouching, leaning or running.
All three men face or look toward the camera and the right-hand wall.
The men stand just outside the open car doors, in front of the car.
The grey car has its doors open and the headlights on.
The men are lit mostly from the side by the headlight spill.
The yard, wall and car match the blank plate, with no other changes to the room.
The three men are at a scale consistent with the room and with Archie's scale in the wall-lean shot.
No knife or other weapon is visible in anyone's hands, waistband or pockets.
No legible text or logos anywhere in the image.
No player face is shown (the player is never seen).
Nothing story-critical sits in the bottom ~10% of the image.
The focal point survives the small-phone crop.
